newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca says Pharmacopeia deal modest but promising.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca says Pharmacopeia deal modest but promising.

text.p: Zeneca Pharmaceuticals, a unit of British pharmaceuticals group Zeneca Group Plc, said on Wednesday its collaboration deal with U.S. group Pharmacopeia Inc. was "modest" but had considerable potential.

"The upfront payment is relatively modest...By that I would say well under $10 million. The deal itself is fairly typical in terms of licensing fees attached to it. But the true value of the deal will only emerge in the future as compounds are developed," a Zeneca Pharmaceuticals official told Reuters.
Zeneca has declined to comment on the precise cost of the three-year agreement announced earlier on Wednesday.
Under the terms of the deal, Pharmacopeia will design, synthesise and provide new discovery libraries of compounds for screening in a wide range of Zeneca's internal assays.
Pharmacopeia's discovery libraries will be licensed to Zeneca, which will receive exclusive commercial rights to any compounds it discovers using the libraries.
